page.meta_description: Romeo is the Montague youth who leaves Rosaline for Juliet, kills Tybalt after Mercutio dies, and drinks poison when he thinks Juliet is dead. Related…
page.content:
Montague who loves Juliet and dies beside her in the Capulet tomb.

How Romeo connects

  • Work: Romeo and Juliet — Romeo is the Montague lover of Romeo and Juliet.
  • Character: Juliet — Romeo and Juliet are the secret married lovers of the play.

What is Romeo?

Romeo is the Montague youth who leaves Rosaline for Juliet, kills Tybalt after Mercutio dies, and drinks poison when he thinks Juliet is dead.

Key threads lead to Romeo and Juliet and Juliet.
